Hi Marta — thanks for sending these over and for the clear remit instructions. A few quick items from our side so we can complete the vendor record and issue the first PO: 

1) Can you confirm the legal entity we should pay for invoices issued to Redwood (Aurora Analytics EU Ltd vs Aurora USA Inc)?
2) For wires, do you require any additional intermediary/bank routing or beneficiary reference beyond the IBAN/SWIFT provided?
3) We typically put PO# on the remittance reference. Will PO-8923 be acceptable to appear alongside the invoice number on the payment reference?

If helpful, I can route the attachment to Finance to kick off the micro-deposit/wire test. We aim to have the vendor active in our system and the PO issued by end of day tomorrow pending confirmation.

Thanks — Jonas
